translations.web: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.
translations.bsb: Because the land was at peace, Asa built fortified cities in Judah. In those days no one made war with him, because the LORD had given him rest.
translations.kjv: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
translations.asv: And he built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Jehovah had given him rest.
